# react-state

Use when the user asks for react state work.

## Workflow
1. Distinguish local UI state, shared state and server data.
2. Avoid duplicated derived state and unnecessary effects.
3. Ensure loading, error and cancellation paths.
4. Keep immutable updates and stable keys.
5. Test user workflows and rerender behavior.

## Verification
State which checks were executed, what passed, and what could not be verified. Favor existing project conventions. Use local resources; do not require network access merely to read this skill.
